dimensions_m.status: Illustrative adult pronghorn-sized design envelope; not an Ilingoceros specimen measurement.
dimensions_m.tolerance: Up to about 10 percent around design dimensions for coherent stance; preserve a long horn-dominated silhouette. Record intentional changes rather than claiming a fossil measurement.

horn_design.twist_interpretation: Paired mirrored torsion of rounded ridged sections around a nearly straight continuous axis. Numeric values, mirrored counterpart, taper and sheath thickness are conservative construction choices, not specimen measurements.
horn_design.fork_interpretation: Small terminal fork inferred from genus-level evidence; not a tall anterior mid-shaft prong or an antler rack.
horn_design.ridge_topology: Integrate ridges in the same continuous horn loft surface, not a detached spiral tube; smoothly change section with sufficient longitudinal sampling.

materials_note: Convert sRGB to linear for node/baseColorFactor values. Metallic 0; opaque; restrained roughness. Palette is an artistic choice.
dependency_policy: Copy canonical helper dependencies to source/deps with relative imports and exact SHA-256 inventory before building. Pin actual runtime/exporter, seed, parameters and viewer version at build time; prep does not claim those probes have run.
